player_prompt.intro:
Qam kawallu {player_id} kaq Chopsticks pukllapi. Turnoykita, kaykunamanta huk akllay:
  + Ataka:  '[attack M O]'  may M=chankay (0 icha 1), O=yanapaqpa chankaynin (0 icha 1).
    - Yanapaqpa chankaynin qullqaynin qawachin chankaynikiwan; >=5 kaptinqa, 0 tukukun.
  + Ch'iqan:   '[split L R]'  chankayniki qullqayta L R icha (L+R = qullqayniki).
Huklla kamachiykita willay.

invalid_move.invalid_command: Mana allin kuti. Usan “[attack M O]” icha “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id}qa, P{opp_id}pa makinman {opp_idx}ta hap'in: kaypi rikch'akun {opp_val}manta {new_val}kama.
